slow = ta.ema(close, 89)

shortCondition = ta.crossunder(fast, slow) and r < 45.0

if shortCondition
    strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short)

    strategy.close("Long")

    strategy.close("Short")

breakoutLow = ta.lowest(low, 20)[1]
atr14 = ta.atr(14)
rangeRatio = (high - low) / atr14
longCondition = close > breakoutHigh and rangeRatio > 1.2
shortCondition = close < breakoutLow and rangeRatio > 1.2
if longCondition
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)
if shortCondition
    strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short)
